title: Widget has many issues
body: To my experience this company never does anything well. The widget is bright blue color and u cant change it. You only can widget with “my day” folder in case you want small widget and there is no option to change visible folder in small widget. But the issue is “my day” folder is the one that cleans all tasks at 00:00, so I want to change to other folder but it is only possible with large widgets. Also over complicated design for such a simple app. As Always with this company.

title: Does not sync with Tasks #Useless
body: Until this app does not sync with Outlook tasks and categories its a useless app that will not allow you to use any task management system (like Getting Things Done for example) without having to do double task management in both Tasks and To Do. I really dont undetstand who approved launching this app without its core function...

author: Jurijs39

title: Not even close to wunderlist.
body:
Very disappointed in loosing wunderlist. Used it for years and would continue to fo do. 
This Microsoft substitute to do list is not even close to Wunderlist and it's functionality.. Needs a lot of improvement. 
Please add: 
- widget for ios (see tasks of chosen lists, shortcut to add new tasks and posibility to mark tasks as done directly from widget not opening the app; 
- option to configure main app, hide unneeded/unused sections (for example 'my day'); 
- apps front page us missing quick add button (+) for tasks. At the moment there's them only to make new list and group. Would be nice to be able to configure these too (choose which ones to keep and which ones to hide).  
- and last but not least - another very useful and important settings function is missing: "hide done tasks".
Waiting for improvements.
